content:
Professional storyboard board showing 8 cinematic frames from a luxury penthouse scene, arranged in a clean 2×4 grid. Each frame features a different female character in stylish modern outfits, connected by glowing red FPV camera path arrows.

Sequence: Fly In → Close-Up → Greeting → Pull Back → Next Character.

Include shot numbers, camera movement annotations, cinematic composition, luxury interior, floor-to-ceiling city-view windows, fashion-commercial aesthetic, production planning layout, ultra-realistic photography, clean beige-and-black design, movie previsualization style, 8K.

Title: AI Character Introduction Storyboard
Subtitle: Single-Take FPV Camera Journey
